title: Remove the daemon front-door code the commercial plug host already serves
goal: Vision: V-9. Mandate 84, follow-up to T-GROKCORESIZE-1. Of the five daemon front doors, delete the core implementations that no core caller uses because susi-plug-host serves their plane topics (os_provision::dispatch for daemon.os.provision, ambient::start_report for daemon.ambient.start) together with their core-only tests, then re-pin COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the measured value. Public Rust contracts pinned by crates/susi-daemon/tests/public_daemon_api_contract.rs and the infallible local behaviours (ambient start/pulse, OS sampling, probe_all, privacy persist) stay in core per board 2817/2829/2833/2834/2835. No stubs and no lost function: the commercial DaemonHandlersPlug serves both and tests/daemon_handlers_plug.rs covers the same assertions.

reuse.searched: susi-commercial-apps src/daemon_handlers.rs (dispatch_provision, start_report) and tests/daemon_handlers_plug.rs already serve and test both; rg finds no core caller of either.
